============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (366B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
Methodology: Full decode reads all 11 fields; mutations check city and increment/grow.
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 484 ns | 2,067,996 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 494 ns | 2,025,268 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobuf-py | 1,222 ns | 818,436 | 341 | 2.53x slower |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 564 ns | 1,772,518 | 341 | 1.17x slower |
| msgspec | 815 ns | 1,226,436 | 634 | 1.69x slower |
| msgpack | 2,173 ns | 460,095 | 634 | 4.49x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 6,202 ns | 161,228 | 874 | 12.83x slower |
